on_screen_text.text:
Donald J. Trump @realDonaldTrump

The President of the United States, DONALD J. TRUMP, Vice President of the United States, JD Vance, Secretary of State, Marco Rubio, Ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, and Ambassador to Lebanon, Michel Issa, met today with High Ranking Representatives of Israel and Lebanon in the Oval Office. The Meeting went very well. The United States is going to work with Lebanon in order to help it protect itself from Hezbollah. The Ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon will be extended by THREE WEEKS. I look forward in the near future to hosting the Prime Minister of Israel, Bibi Netanyahu, and the President of Lebanon, Joseph Aoun. It was a Great Honor to be a participant at this very Historic Meeting! President DONALD J. TRUMP

spoken_summary: J.D. Vance announces a "major historic moment," congratulating Israel and Lebanon. He states that the ceasefire between the two nations will be extended for three weeks. Vance gives full credit to President Trump, stating, "it wouldn't have happened without the president's direct engagement" and was the result of "energetic diplomacy, of course, led by the President of the United States." He concludes by saying he is "very proud to be a part of it" and thanks the President for making it happen.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of a man speaking in a formal setting. There is no music or other sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot with no cuts or camera movement. A text overlay, formatted as a social media post, remains on screen for the entire duration.
central_claim: President Trump's direct diplomatic leadership has secured a historic three-week ceasefire extension between Israel and Lebanon.
intended_effect: To portray the Trump administration as effective in foreign policy and successful at brokering peace, thereby inspiring confidence and pride in its leadership.
